name: Trustpilot

sources.title: Trustpilot for Business homepage — 'Create free account' entry point
Trustpilot pricing — Free plan and paid tiers (Starter from $99/mo, annual commitment)
Trustpilot business signup (linked from 'Create free account')

requirements: A business with a live domain/website to claim a Trustpilot profile for
A business account — created free via the signup portal
Reviews come from customers; the business itself cannot write its own reviews
preparation: Business email and the domain to claim
Company details for the public profile (name, logo, description, categories)
Plan for collecting organic reviews — the free tier includes 50 automated review invitations/month
workflow: Check your domain's existing TrustScore/profile on trustpilot.com (profiles can exist before you claim them)
Go to business.trustpilot.com and click 'Create free account' / 'Start for free'
Claim/verify your domain and fill in the business profile
Optionally send review invitations (50/month on Free) and reply to reviews from the dashboard
watchFor: All paid contracts are a 12-month commitment billed annually — Starter from $99/mo, Plus from $319/mo, Premium from $799/mo; don't 'upgrade to see pricing'
Per-domain pricing — each domain in a plan is priced separately
Paid tiers mainly buy invitation volume, widgets, and customization; the free tier already gives a public profile, review collection, and replies
Do not incentivize or fake reviews — Trustpilot enforces company guidelines and removes fake reviews (7.8m removed in 2025 per their homepage)
countsAsLive: A public business profile page at trustpilot.com/review/<domain> showing claimed status and collecting reviews/TrustScore
unknowns: Exact verification method for claiming a domain (email/domain verification flow not documented on the fetched pages)
Whether free-tier profiles appear in Trustpilot category browsing or only via direct search
